title: The Way of Awareness
content_text:
The Way of Awareness

Something happened today that made me really happy.
Here’s what happened:
One of my colleagues reported a problem in the group chat. At first, everyone, including me, started to share possible clues.
After some analysis, it seemed that the issue was caused by my change — but I had a valid reason for it.
However, that colleague got quite emotional, and it looked like he just wanted to put the blame on me.
Reading his messages through the screen, I could feel the discomfort rising inside me.

But soon, I became aware of my emotions.
After taking a short pause, I calmly wrote a detailed message to explain the whole situation.
Then, that guy also became more rational and said “OK.”

Yes, the happiness I felt today came from this small change in myself.
In the past, I had argued with him in the office before.
Even though I believed I was right, I couldn’t express myself well, and I felt frustrated afterward.

Since I started to practice what I learned from The Way of Awareness, I’ve been handling things in a wiser way.
This time, I didn’t get angry — instead, I felt joyful.
That joy even made me want to write down this story. Haha.
